code.text: COAG
PANEL.MICRO

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH, D-dimer). There is also mild hypoalbuminemia, hyperchloremia, and a prolonged INR. These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection or bone marrow suppression, and increased risk of bleeding. No evidence of acute myocardial injury or COVID-19 infection. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
